Return the lexicographically smallest topological ordering, include isolated nodes, and ignore duplicate edges. Raise ValueError for an edge endpoint absent from nodes or a cycle. Do not mutate either input. Use no imports. Return only the complete function in a Python code block.
candidates.apply_edits: Implement apply_edits(text, edits) in Python. Each edit is (start, end, replacement), using original-string half-open indices. Return the string after all edits simultaneously. Accept edits in any order, allow adjacent edits, reject overlapping edits or bounds not satisfying 0 <= start < end <= len(text) with ValueError. Inputs have integer indices and string replacements. Do not mutate edits. Use no imports. Return only the complete function in a Python code block.
candidates.merge_intervals: Implement merge_intervals(intervals) in Python. Each input is a pair of integer endpoints for a closed interval. Reject reversed endpoints with ValueError. Return sorted, merged tuples: merge overlapping intervals and shared endpoints, but never bridge a gap of one. Accept empty and duplicate intervals and do not mutate input. Use no imports. Return only the complete function in a Python code block.
